displayPrecision: nearest whole millimeter; approximate assembled envelope

wallMounted.method: Use native assembly offsets for body/tray, applying the print scale to their combined coordinates. Slicer assembly transforms retain unscaled translations and are not the fitted pose. Width and depth follow the wall-facing orientation, not the rotated print-bed orientation.

freeStanding.source: Spike Vase V03 / Spike Vase - Standing Version package-export snapshot
freeStanding.method: Union of referenced body and cleaned tray vertices in their source assembly positions, with the package uniform scale. Excludes the isolated unused vertex.

scope: Assembled planter body and fitted screw-in tray; no plant. Mesh-derived approximate dimensions, not physical print measurements.
